[[Nighh SpineChill]] is a [[Nightmare]] [[boss]] that spawns in [[Talus Chute]].

== Locations ==
* [[Southern Shiverpeaks]]
** {{NPC location|Talus Chute}}

== Skills ==
13 [[Blood Magic]], 16 [[Curses]] (18 Blood Magic, 20 Curses in [[Hard mode]])
* {{skill icon|Life Siphon}}
* {{skill icon|Spinal Shivers}}
* {{skill icon|Spiteful Spirit}} ([[elite]])
* {{skill icon|Weaken Armor}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Azure Remains]]

== Notes ==
* Nighh SpineChill has three possible spawn locations in Talus Chute, which he shares with three other Nightmare bosses.
* The easiest way to find him is to repeatedly [[zone]] from [[Camp Rankor]] until he spawns at the closest location, which allows for finding him with minimal effort.
* This boss spawns with a couple of [[Azure Shadow]]s, thus it is wise to take skills that prevent [[knock down]] because of [[Signet of Judgment]].
